### Ralph Waldo Emerson on authenticity

Ralph Waldo Emerson (1803–1882) approaches authenticity within Transcendentalism. Self-reliance trusts the aboriginal self against conformity and secondhand creed. Nature is a symbol and discipline of spirit, not dead resource only. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets authenticity most directly—useful for searches such as “ralph waldo emerson quotes on authenticity.”
